| macOS 14 *Sonoma* (released 2023) | **Sonoma** – City of Sonoma, California | City | **38.2919 ° N, 122.4580 ° W** |

```

macOS 13 – Ventura → 34.2746 N, 119.2290 W (Ventura, CA)
macOS 12 – Monterey → 36.6002 N, 121.8947 W (Monterey, CA)
```
